reviews.comment: Professor Hutchins did a great job of keeping the lectures interesting. Assignments are straightforward and take up time but very manageable. There is a midterm and final but the case studies are heavily weighted so put effort in. She does a great job of telling us what is expected or what we should study. Put in effort you can get an A.

The lectures were an absolute snoozefest, but she tries her best to engage us regardless. Very kind and fair, and the weekly assignments weren't too terrible, but she does grade kind of particularly on the case studies. Other than that, she's a pretty fair grader and it shouldn't be difficult to get an easy A in the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The professor is very nice, but the class is so boring. I've heard that the other professors are more engaging, but Professor Hutchins isn't bad. She looks for very specific things on the essays, but its not too hard of a class.

Alot of writing, but she is not a bad professor. The class is not the most entertaining, but you can tell she tries by bringing in other people. Overall, not a bad professor, just not a great one either. She is a very nice person though.
The sweetest soul i have no idea how she could have a single bad review. If you need help she wants you to talk to her. She is so understanding, and she makes an effort to get to know her students.

This class was very straightforward! We had 3 essays as long as you hit each point, you're guaranteed a good grade. As for the exams, as long as you studied the vocab well, you can get above a B on the exams. Her lectures are not hard to understand shes just very calm but she's very helpful and can always send her emails.

I honestly loved having Dr. H as a professor. She is one of the few professors that truly cares about you and wants you to succeed. The lectures did feel very long and at times where occasionally a little boring but overall it was not a bad class. I definitely recommend her as a professor I promise you wont regret it.
Attendance is mandatory but the class is just SOOOOOOO boringggggg. Professor Hutchins even tells the class that she knows it is boring and "tries" to make it better, but never works out.

Dr. Hutchins gave you all the tools you needed to succeed. Class was boring but attendance was a grade. Two group presentations, one midterm, and a final with around 3 essays to write. Peerceptive was annoying but at least it was fairly easy. Loved my peer leaders though! (TS)

Overall this class is not hard, the professor is quite boring and honestly every class turned into me doing work for other class (or watching DBZ) but overall she is fine. There is not much of a point to listening to her lectures. I cant speak for everyone but my peer leaders were great. The class is very paper heavy so practice practice.

Boring lectures, just reads off the screen. She does not give clear and proper feedback on papers but she is lenient when grading. Quizzes are open note and if you study a bit, tests will be fine for you. But she is a nice professor and easy to contact.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's really sweet and genuinely cares about her students. Make an effort to get to know her because it makes the class so much better.

Boring professor. Lectures are also pretty boring with awkward questions throughout. Peer leaders are a hit or miss. Grading criteria is clear. Tests are easy, weekly quizzes are easy, papers are decent, and the group projects are challenging but fun.
